body: Commission for Women and Girls - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 22, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM
Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Commission for Women and Girls In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  Alanah.Grant@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 939 3435 2621
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93934352621

 Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access and
  public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54910  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, March 25, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54911  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Long Beach Early
  Childhood Education Committee on early care and education in Long Beach,
  including an update on the Citywide Early Childhood Education Strategic Plan and
  its impact on the community.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54912  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Low Income
  Investment Fund on California Assembly Bill 2006 and Assembly Bill 1914, and the
  legislation’s impact on women and girls in Long Beach.

  Page 1 of 2
   COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 22, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54913  Recommendation to discuss and approve the transmittal of a letter to Mayor and
  City Council regarding measures to strengthen the Long Beach Values Act, aligned
  with advocacy of the Long Beach Justice Fund Coalition.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54914  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

4.  26-62009  Recommendation to discuss and approve the transmittal of a letter to Mayor and
  City Council regarding measures to strengthen the Long Beach Values Act, aligned
  with advocacy of the Long Beach Justice Fund Coalition.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Anckle, seconded by Commissioner
  Donato-Sapp, to approve recommendation, as amended, to remove the
  following sentence from page two of the letter: Additionally, due to a lack of
  evidence as to how this technology contributes to solving crimes or locating
  criminals as well as an excessive cost to the City Budget, we stand behind
  the coalition’s recommendation to ban the use of ALPR and FRT. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Allen Harper, Anckle, Donato-Sapp, Gonzalez, LaViolette
  No:  1  Mehlinger
